measures: for how many of the cards a user sees does a "try another track" button appear at all -- and does it disappear exactly for the obscure artists?
note: Interiors only. Endpoints excluded -- they are the user's own picks. Candidates are de-duplicated by normalised title, so a count of 3 means three distinct titles; it does NOT collapse 'Song' and 'Song (Remastered 2011)'. Counts are CENSORED at clip_search_limit: a row reading 25 means 'at least 25'.

rows.name: And So I Watch You From Afar
